Episode Notes:
On Aug. 7, leaders of Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan signed the Mecca Joint Defense Agreement. Kerry talks with Michael Kugelman about the pact, what each country brings to the table, their shared interests, and how they're working to maintain relations with Washington while also looking toward regional arrangements for security.
